import asyncio
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import platform
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from importlib.metadata import version
from importlib.resources import files
from pathlib import Path

from mcp import ClientSession, StdioServerParameters
from mcp.client.stdio import stdio_client
import tuik_mcp
from tuik_mcp.search.schema import index_definition

OUT = Path('/Users/baha/Desktop/All/Ders/4.1/CMPE492/Project/docs/verification/v0.3.0-final-wheel-2026-11-05.json')
ROOT = Path('/Users/baha/Desktop/All/Ders/4.1/CMPE492/Project')

async def main():
    module_path = Path(tuik_mcp.__file__).resolve()
    assert not module_path.is_relative_to(ROOT)
    assert 'site-packages' in str(module_path)
    assert version('tuik-mcp') == '0.3.0'
    assert importlib.util.find_spec('matplotlib') is None
    assert importlib.util.find_spec('opensearchpy') is None
    assets = {name: hashlib.sha256(files('tuik_mcp.search').joinpath(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
              for name in ['analysis.json', 'mapping.json', 'synonyms.txt']}
    mapping = index_definition()['mappings']
    assert mapping['dynamic'] == 'strict' and mapping['_meta']['schema_version'] == 2
    executable = str(Path(sys.executable).parent / 'tuik-mcp')
    async with stdio_client(StdioServerParameters(command=executable)) as (read, write):
        async with ClientSession(read, write) as session:
            await session.initialize()
            tools = (await session.list_tools()).tools
            names = {tool.name for tool in tools}
            assert names == {'search_tuik','search_tuik_datasets','get_tuik_resource','get_tuik_data',
                             'inspect_tuik_data','chart_tuik_data','read_tuik_document',
                             'list_tuik_themes','search_tuik_classifications'}
            schemas = {tool.name: tool.inputSchema for tool in tools}
            assert {'query','cursor'} <= set(schemas['get_tuik_data']['properties'])
            assert {'kind','theme','live','published_after','published_before','downloadable_only'} <= set(schemas['search_tuik']['properties'])
            invalid = await session.call_tool('get_tuik_resource', {'resource_id':'invalid'})
            assert invalid.structuredContent['code'] == 'invalid_input'
            cursor = await session.call_tool('get_tuik_data', {'resource_id':'flow:DF_ALTINSIZ_DTH+V1.0','cursor':'malformed'})
            assert cursor.structuredContent['code'] == 'invalid_cursor'
    index_help = subprocess.run([str(Path(sys.executable).parent / 'tuik-mcp-index'), '--help'], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    assert '--full' in index_help.stdout and '--alternate-listing-mode' in index_help.stdout
    hashes = {path.name: hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
              for path in sorted(Path('/tmp/tuik-v030-dist').iterdir()) if path.is_file()}
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps({
        'status':'ok','checked_at':datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
        'package_version':version('tuik-mcp'),'python_version':platform.python_version(),
        'module_path':str(module_path),'cwd':str(Path.cwd()),'tools':sorted(names),
        'console_entry_points':['tuik-mcp','tuik-mcp-index'],
        'invalid_id_code':invalid.structuredContent['code'],
        'invalid_cursor_code':cursor.structuredContent['code'],
        'schema_version':mapping['_meta']['schema_version'], 'packaged_assets_sha256':assets,
        'optional_viz_installed':False,'optional_search_client_installed':False,
        'candidate_artifacts_sha256':hashes,
        'artifact_scope':'Candidate build, not published/tagged artifacts; rebuild from the accepted tag',
        'harness':Path(__file__).read_text(),
    },ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
    print('Wheel acceptance passed: 0.3.0, nine tools, entry points, schema/assets, invalid inputs, base-only install')

asyncio.run(main())
